svg.text: Agent engineering is data + system + evals. DSPy (signatures, modules, optimizers) and

svg.text: LangGraph (state, nodes, edges) speed up building, the harness shapes behavior, and

svg.text: Temporal plus tracing keep long runs reliable. Start simple and let evals justify added

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 智能体工程 = 数据 + 系统 + 评估。DSPy（签名、模块、优化器）和 LangGraph（状态、节点、边）让

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 构建更快，运行框架决定行为，Temporal 和追踪工具让长时间运行保持可靠。从简单做起，用评估来

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 证明增加复杂度是值得的。
